subject.title: feat(ios): export chat transcripts as Markdown via the share sheet

question: After the visible-row export bugs and real-proof gap are resolved, should OpenClaw accept iOS Markdown transcript export as part of the broader iOS chat polish direction?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing iOS feature tied to an open umbrella issue and carries a protected maintainer label, so implementation correctness alone does not settle product acceptance.

options.title: Accept after blockers
options.body: Land transcript export after visible-row parity, transient-state behavior, security review, and real iOS proof are all clean.

options.title: Narrow or defer export
options.body: Keep the broader iOS polish work open but pause this export surface for more design or privacy review.

options.title: Decline core export
options.body: Close or pause this PR if transcript export should not be part of the iOS app now.

recommendation.title: Accept after blockers
recommendation.body: Land transcript export after visible-row parity, transient-state behavior, security review, and real iOS proof are all clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history owner for the iOS chat surface and the protected feature direction.
